description:
Encuentra el color más cercano (variando solo la luminosidad OKLCH) que alcanza un contraste WCAG objetivo contra un fondo. Cuándo: hay que calcular con exactitud colores, contrastes o paletas, p. ej. para revisar accesibilidad. No para: calcular la relación de contraste WCAG entre dos colores (color-contrast). Efectos secundarios: ninguno (solo lectura, sin red, sin estado guardado). Determinista: la misma entrada da la misma salida. Límites: entrada JSON de hasta 64 KB, 1 s por llamada, resultado de hasta 1 MB.

EN: Finds the closest color to a foreground (changing only OKLCH lightness, keeping hue) that reaches a target WCAG contrast ratio against a background, trying darker and lighter directions. When: color values, contrast or palettes have to be computed exactly, e.g. for accessibility checks. Not for: computing the WCAG contrast ratio of two colors (color-contrast). Side effects: none (read-only, no network access, no stored state). [EN completo / full EN: inputSchema.description]

inputSchema.description: EN: Finds the closest color to a foreground (changing only OKLCH lightness, keeping hue) that reaches a target WCAG contrast ratio against a background, trying darker and lighter directions. When: color values, contrast or palettes have to be computed exactly, e.g. for accessibility checks. Not for: computing the WCAG contrast ratio of two colors (color-contrast). Side effects: none (read-only, no network access, no stored state). Deterministic: the same input gives the same output. Limits: JSON input up to 64 KB, 1 s per call, result up to 1 MB.

foreground.description: Color to adjust (string; required; up to 100 chars).

target_ratio.description: Target ratio (number; optional; default 4.5; min 1; max 21).
